present.label: Read the diary
present.story: {n} mornings of prices. Buy once, sell once later.
present.formal: prices has {n} values. Maximise prices[j] − prices[i] for i < j.

initialize.label: Start on day 0
initialize.story: So far the cheapest morning is day 0, at {price}. No profit yet.

cheaper.label: A cheaper morning
cheaper.story: Day {day} costs {price}, cheaper than {oldPrice}. Any later sale should buy here instead.

sell-check:record.label: Check selling today
sell-check:record.story: Selling on day {day} at {price}, after buying at {buyPrice} on day {buyDay}, earns {profit}. A new best.

sell-check:keep.label: Check selling today
sell-check:keep.story: Selling on day {day} at {price}, after buying at {buyPrice}, would earn {profit}. The best stays {best}.

done:profit.label: Return the best
done:profit.story: The best plan buys on day {buyDay} and sells on day {sellDay}, earning {best}.

done:none.label: No profit
done:none.story: No sale ever made money, so the best plan is not to trade: 0.
